investigation_notes.Description: Anomalous DNS traffic was observed: 740 bytes of high-entropy TXT queries to ntp-update.space from 10.150.22.15 targeting 185.112.10.4 on srv-prod-web-02. The TXT sample_queries appear to embed encoded host, OS and uptime data, suggesting possible data being carried through DNS tunneling. ntp-update.space is 25 days old and lacks long-standing reputation; when combined with the encoded payloads and elevated DNS activity, this pattern is suspicious and merits escalation for containment and investigation.
investigation_notes.Encoded Payload Detected: Yes, sample_queries contain TXT records with base64-encoded strings representing hostname, os, uptime, and cmd.
